evidence.reason: Line 102 still invokes the pinned gitleaks v8.30.1 against the checked-out repository without neutralizing the repository-controlled `.gitleaksignore`. In that version, `--config` selects rules but does not disable the source-local ignore file, so a PR can add its own fingerprint and bypass the fail-closed denylist. The contract requires the denylist to remain blocking/fail-closed (item 17), making this an existing-behavior security defect rather than a new hardening request.
